name: Scaleway Managed Databases
line: Managed PostgreSQL and MySQL with backups, replicas, and pgvector support.

free.text: Startups: up to €1,000/12mo; no idle expiry; unpaid service may be deleted

cells.selfhost: No, Scaleway hosts the managed service

sql.math: 730 hours × €0.0156 an hour = €11.388 for compute. Add €0.0993 per GB of storage a month, €0.03 per GB of backups a month, plus transfer and extras. The amounts for these are not set.

Idle still bills for 730 provisioned hours: €11.388 for compute, plus €0.0993 per GB of storage a month and €0.03 per GB of backups a month, for amounts that are not set. Transfer and extras are also not set.

files.math: Scaleway Managed Databases does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: pg_cron schedules SQL on the paid database. The €11.388 compute part remains, but job capacity and the full database cost are unknown.
